title: narcissus pumilus
intro: Narcissus pumilus, commonly known as the dwarf narcissus, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Narcissus pumilus are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids like galantamine, which may have neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory effects. Furthermore, research suggests that the plant's bioactive constituents may also exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant properties.
